name: partial-line
description: Same shape as 'slow' — spaced-out steps so a test can read events.ndjson mid-run. The fake binary always writes one full JSON line per write() call (docs/02 §8: flush is incremental, but per-line, never mid-line), so a genuinely torn line at the *source* cannot be produced without editing agy.mjs. Real partial-line bytes are constructed by the integration test itself, appending an unterminated fragment directly to a job's events.ndjson and asserting events/cursor.ts's readLinesFrom() withholds it until the newline arrives. This scenario just supplies enough wall-clock spacing (delay_ms) for that test to land its write between two real lines.
